protocol.break_even: If a mixed workload has positive gross observed lower-envelope saving, report ceil(cold_setup_ns / gross_saving_ns) only as a conditional amortization threshold. It is not measured net profit, production demand, an acceptance criterion or NDU superiority.
protocol.cost_boundary: Cold bank setup is measured from captured-source preparation through fresh source/kernel proofs, complete baseline and candidate proof/compile/native differential, driver build and sealed publication. All baseline and losing-candidate setup is charged once. This cold setup is the conservative optimization cost. The later 210 controlled performance observations, their trace preparation/oracles and serialization are evaluation overhead, retained separately and in complete-study wall; they are not silently labeled online NDU decision cost.

data.selection: First 65536 bytes of each phase; 64 consecutive 1024-byte requests with independent CRC state. Both phase inputs fixed before timing. Seven trials repeat these same inputs; they are not seven independently sampled workloads.

protocol.deadline_scope: Acceptance deadline checked between bounded operations; not a hard global preemption guarantee. Individual children and solver queries retain separate fixed limits.
protocol.economic_gate: On each workload and in both phases: minimum complete coalesced-static observation over all three static arms minus maximum poly-dispatch observation minus complete cold bank setup cost must be positive on this one finite trace. Distinct candidate code and correct complete lifecycles are required. This is a conservative cold finite-job gate against already-available static controls, not a claim that static build cost was zero in an independently constructed application. No future horizon or projected repetitions grant admission.
protocol.metric: Sum complete native context outer wall for the exact trace, from bounded child creation through load/calls/unload/exit and result validation. Fresh arm sums 64 complete child lifecycles. Full arm preparation + input hashing + Python oracle + result validation outer wall is also separately retained. No inner-loop timing is accepted as whole-path net gain.
protocol.ndu_followup: This is an execution-context and fixed-policy study. NDU is not one of its five arms. A successful economic gate would only motivate a separately preregistered equal-budget native NDU versus complete enumeration and simple-search comparison; no advice, deployment or publication authority follows.
protocol.ordering: Training then validation; workload order rotates by trial. Arm order rotates by trial plus workload index and reverses on odd trials.
proof_requirements: all-input bounded captured Core bridge, truncation edge UNSAT
all-input candidate value and first-trap equivalence
sealed actual native images and bounded child lifetime
protocol.purpose: Finite execution-context reuse and guarded specialization opportunity, with coalesced static controls. No NDU superiority or production-demand assertion.
protocol.reuse_attribution: Fresh-child to coalesced-static savings measure execution-context batching only. They never establish NDU, specialization or global optimization value.
protocol.sampling: No warmup, retry, automatic replay, outlier removal or omitted failed sample. Every attempted request and retained completed prefix remain evidence.
protocol.source_application: examples/hia_filecheck/checksum.c via the real captured C frontend, separately proved finite loop-to-kernel bridge
protocol.static_control_policy: The three coalesced static arms each load exactly one referenced image. Poly-dispatch loads only its referenced images and chooses the known polynomial guard at request boundaries. This fixed dispatch is an oracle-like strong control, not an online NDU policy.
protocol.target: Linux x86_64 LP64; native current-host execution only
